summary: Elevra Lithium Limited, an Australian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form -6K with two exhibits filed on the ASX on October 16, 2026: its 2026 Notice of Annual General Meeting and an announcement titled 'Elevra Announced Planned Board Transition.' The AGM is scheduled for November 19, 2026, held as a hybrid meeting in Brisbane, with voting eligibility set at 7:00pm AEDT on November 17, 2026. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock are disclosed; the board transition is described as planned rather than an abrupt forced departure. No special-situation event is presented; monitor AGM resolutions and director succession only.
